# ctables/div

> Division: `/` on two `int`s, rounding toward zero.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/div.pkg) · translates [std/div](../std/div.md)

  Dividing by zero, or the most negative number by -1, crashes the program
  with `SIGFPE`, as with bintables' `idiv`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
{L.a} / {L.b}; })
```

Includes: [ctables/binop](binop.md)
